mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset_favorite f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_favorite (user_id, dataset_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{datasetId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

MERGE INTO dataset_favorite t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS u, #{datasetId} AS d FROM DUAL) s ON (t.user_id = s.u AND t.dataset_id = s.d) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, dataset_id) VALUES (s.u, s.d)
